mapper.select: select * from crm_outbound_webhook_delivery where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status in ('pending', 'retrying') and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now}) order by coalesce(next_retry_at, create_time) asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update crm_outbound_webhook_delivery set status = #{status}, attempt = #{attempt}, http_status = #{httpStatus}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, request_id = #{requestId}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
